0022600111.text: The Warriors (0-2, 13th in the West) visit the Suns (0-1, 15th in the West) with Golden State on a two-game losing streak and Phoenix also still looking for its first win. In the head-to-head history, the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 101-97 win in Phoenix on February 5, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series. Golden State currently lists Brandin Podziemski, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody as out, with Charles Bassey and Stephen Curry day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Phoenix lists Mark Williams as out and Luke Kennard and Oso Ighodaro as day-to-day and game-time decisions.
